About

Build systems. Invest wisely. Live better.

Hi, I’m AV — a DevOps & Cloud engineer in Ontario helping companies ship faster and safer.
On this site, I share field-tested playbooks on DevOps, AI & automation, and money (Canada-focused personal finance and investing).

What I’m good at

  • Turning messy pipelines and infra into boring, reliable systems
  • Designing pragmatic AWS architectures (ECS/EKS, CloudFront/WAF, RDS/S3/KMS)
  • Making incidents rarer and recoveries faster (SLOs, alerts, runbooks)
  • Finding cost wins without sacrificing reliability
  • Packaging all of the above into docs & templates teams can reuse

What you’ll find here

  • Step-by-step guides and templates you can copy/paste
  • DevOps & SRE notes from real production work
  • Personal finance (Canada) and investing frameworks you can stick with
  • Occasional football analysis and life notes
